title: Mission Charter
description: Structured mission contract produced by PM Agent (AGENT-01-PM) from natural-language operator input. Consumed by CEO Agent (AGENT-02-CEO) to decompose and assign pod workloads.

schema_version.description: Semver-style schema version stamp; producers set this on every emitted instance.

charter_id.description: Unique identifier for this charter instance.

mission_id.description: Stable mission identifier this charter belongs to.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the charter was created.

requested_by.description: Operator or system identity that initiated the mission.

mission_mode.description: Numbered mission mode selected by the operator (1–10).

mission_mode_label.description: Human-readable label for the selected mission mode.

depth_mode.description: Controls the depth of analysis and artifact generation.

output_mode.description: Controls the form of mission outputs delivered to the operator.

target.description: Describes the codebase or artifact the mission acts on.

path.description: Local filesystem path when type is local_repo.

repo_url.description: Remote repository URL when type is github_repo.

branch.description: Branch to operate on when type is github_repo or local_repo.

primary_language.description: Primary language of the target, normalized to registry form.

detected_languages.description: All languages detected in the target repository.

aim_artifact_id.description: ID of the Application Intelligence Map artifact generated for this target, if available.

objective.description: PM Agent's structured restatement of the operator's natural-language goal.
examples: Add JWT-authenticated user sessions to the FastAPI service and cover them with integration tests.

raw_input.description: Original natural-language input from the operator, preserved verbatim for traceability.

scope.description: Explicit scope boundaries agreed between PM Agent and the operator.

in_scope.description: Capabilities, files, or concerns explicitly included.

out_of_scope.description: Items explicitly excluded from this mission.

assumptions.description: Assumptions PM Agent made when clarification was not available.

success_criteria.description: Measurable conditions that must be true for the mission to be considered successful.
examples: New integration tests cover the happy path and token expiry

definition_of_done.description: Structured DoD derived from the selected depth_mode.

gates.description: Ordered list of required approval gates before mission is COMPLETE.

requires_operator_approval.description: Whether the mission requires explicit operator sign-off before COMPLETE.

requires_runtime_qc.description: Whether AI Runtime QC (AGENT-41-RQCA) must run before COMPLETE.

requires_dependency_absorption.description: Whether dependency absorption analysis (AGENT-39-DEPABS) must complete.

non_functional_constraints.description: Non-functional requirements that constrain the mission execution.

max_token_budget.description: Maximum total tokens across all agents for this mission.

max_wall_time_seconds.description: Maximum wall-clock time in seconds before mission is forcibly failed.

sensitive_code_tier.description: Sensitive code handling tier for the target (0=public, 1=internal, 2=sensitive, 3=regulated).

provider_restriction.description: Restrict LLM routing to a specific provider (e.g. 'local_only' for Tier 3).

checkpoint.description: Checkpoint state for autonomous long-run missions that support resume.

last_gate_passed.description: The last gate successfully passed before the most recent failure.

resume_from.description: The gate to resume from on next execution attempt.

metadata.description: Freeform metadata for operator tagging, CI correlation, or audit correlation.

examples.objective: Add JWT-authenticated user sessions to the FastAPI service and cover them with integration tests.
examples.raw_input: Add login with JWT to the FastAPI app

assumptions: PostgreSQL is available as the session store
Existing user table has email and password_hash columns

success_criteria: Protected routes return 401 without a valid token
Integration tests cover happy path and token expiry
